name: RMK (Russkaya Mednaya Kompaniya)
note: Club partner of HC Traktor (club site footer); RMK was reported as the club's title sponsor with 100m roubles a year when the deal began (1obl.ru and fedpress.ru, both unreachable from the research environment — see PR). On the 2026-27 home jersey the RMK mark sits on the shoulder yoke and on the helmet back (club match photos). Held at unrated: the ownership claim rests on a single, undated TAdviser dossier whose visible content is years old (it cites Forbes 2012), and the PR itself notes the current holding structure may differ from what that dossier implies. RMK is one of Russia's largest copper miners, so METHOD.md's company test applies: the Business & Human Rights Centre records allegations around RMK projects (intimidation of opponents and sidestepped consultation at the Salavatskoye exploration in Bashkortostan, business-humanrights.org, May 2025), and RMK's Tominsky GOK near Chelyabinsk faced years of protests with reported attacks on Stop-GOK activists. No court, regulator, UN or major-NGO finding was located, but a maintainer should weigh this before any 'none'.
